truncated_or_partial_sources: All help center pages were accessed only via search engine index snippets, which may omit sections of the original page. Gumroad category pages are JS-rendered and only sidebar/meta content was recoverable from search engine index.
source_type_ambiguities: The shard declares allowed source_type as `product_listing, search_results_page, platform_doc`. The protocol requires help_center (a more specific value than platform_doc) for help center articles. Used help_center per protocol's specificity rule; downstream operators may map help_center → platform_doc if needed for shard alignment.
